question.question: can i extend my metirnaty leave ?

results.actual_answer: I see you've switched topics from insurance to maternity leave. How can I assist you with your maternity leave extension? Great question! Yes, you can request an extension to your maternity leave. If you’re considering extending your time away, you’ll need to reach out to your Line Manager and get their approval before your current leave period ends. There are a few options for extending your leave: You can use any accumulated annual leave days. You may request unpaid leave. If you have a medical reason and a supporting medical report, you can apply for sick leave. It’s important to have your Line Manager’s approval for any extension. Taking extra leave without proper approval could be viewed as unauthorized or illegitimate absence, which may result in disciplinary action, as outlined in the HRD - GEN - 004 - Maternity and Paternity Leaves - P - 13.md policy. Also, just so you know, your annual leave keeps accruing while you’re on maternity leave, and all your contractual benefits stay in place during this period. If you need help with the process or aren’t sure which forms to use, your HR department can guide you. And if you’d like to read the full policy details, you can check the HRD - GEN - 004 - Maternity and Paternity Leaves - P - 13.md document. question.question: what is road and when am i eligable for it

results.actual_answer: I see you've shifted from discussing leave policies to asking about 'road' and your eligibility for it. Great question! 'Remote working leave' is a policy that allows eligible back-office employees to work from home or another location, rather than being physically present in the office. You're typically eligible if your job can be performed remotely and you meet certain criteria, such as: If you're unwell or caring for a direct family member Emergency travel outside your base country If you can't attend or deliver online training at the office Working during annual leaves Any other significant reason Eligible employees can use up to 30 cumulative days of remote working leave per year, but please note that this is always subject to your line manager’s approval. If you'd like to confirm your eligibility or need more details on the application process, I recommend reaching out to the HR department directly.
